instruction: I have difficulty pressing multiple keys simultaneously. Could you enable sticky keys so I can press modifier keys one at a time?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: STICKY_KEYS=$(timeout 10 gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard stickykeys-enable 2>/dev/null); if [ "$STICKY_KEYS" = "true" ]; then echo "Sticky keys enabled"; else echo "No sticky keys enabled"; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling sticky keys for users who have difficulty pressing multiple keys simultaneously. Evaluator checks if stickykeys-enable is set to true using gsettings. Similar difficulty to original task - both are single accessibility settings. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary score: 1.0 if sticky keys are enabled, 0.0 otherwise
